capability.skillsWriteDeferred: Installing or enabling Skills is not available yet; Skills are read-only.
capability.scriptInstallerManaged: Installed by the vendor's script installer; Nexus never runs install scripts. Update it with the Agent's own updater.
capability.launchMacOnly: Launching is available on macOS only for now.
capability.onlineDeferred: Online credential and Provider validation is not implemented.
capability.claudeMcpAgentOwned: Claude Code keeps user MCP servers in its own state file (~/.claude.json); Nexus reads it but does not edit it. Use 'claude mcp'.
capability.wingetUnverified: WinGet installation has not been verified yet.
capability.unknownInstaller: The installation source is unknown, so Nexus will not update or remove it.
capability.nativeUninstallManual: Native Claude Code installs are removed manually, following the official instructions.
capability.opencodeAmbiguousConfig: Two global configuration files exist; edits are blocked until they are merged.
